data.name: SMA vacuum feedthrough
data.function: Hermetic SMA bulkhead in the top plate carrying one microwave line from the room-temperature rack into the vacuum. Its insertion loss is negligible compared with the cryogenic attenuators, but a leaking feedthrough is the most common cause of a slowly rising OVC pressure. The input power referenced here is the power leaving the rack cable.

physics.summary: Vacuum-tight RF connector; entry point of each line.

data.tooltip: Hermetic SMA feedthrough for one microwave line.
